### Unwavering Obedience
Author: Dr. Michael Youssef
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-week-of-october-24.html
Passage: 1 Kings 18:21
Points:
- Elijah challenged the Israelites on Mount Carmel for hesitating between God and Baal.
- Straddling two sides produces double-minded, lukewarm believers who are easily swayed by the world.
- Despite overwhelming numbers against him, Elijah displayed confidence in God and repaired the neglected altar.
- Believers are urged to repent of compromise and renew daily wholehearted devotion to the Lord.

### Beware the god of Open Options
Author: Barry Cooper
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/god-open-options/
Passage: 1 Kings 18:21
Points:
- Elijah confronted the silent Israelites for attempting to keep their spiritual options open.
- Modern culture glorifies noncommitment, but perpetually hedging one's bets leads to paralysis and spiritual ruin.
- Delaying a decisive choice for God reflects a fundamental lack of trust in His sovereignty.
- God proved His ultimate commitment to His people through the sacrifice of Christ on the cross.
- Christians are called to cast aside double-minded hesitation and follow the Lord wholeheartedly.

### Elijah and the Prophets of Baal
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/elijah-and-prophets-baal
Passage: 1 Kings 18:20–40
Points:
- Elijah stepped forward to confront the syncretistic idolatry poisoning Israel's worship.
- God will not accept divided loyalty or halfhearted commitment from His people.
- Though completely outnumbered, Elijah rested in God's word and soaked the altar to magnify God's power.
- Believers must look to the Creator alone, recognizing that true satisfaction cannot be shared with worldly idols.
